name: EEVL Media Production Workflow
description: End-to-end media production pipeline for Eagle Eye Vision Labz. Covers the 3-pillar model: Video + Drone + Photo — from client brief intake through final delivery and invoicing.

tasks.name: Pre-Production
tasks.description: Client brief analysis, shot list generation, equipment planning, scheduling, and project channel creation.

tasks.name: Shoot Day
tasks.description: On-location shoot execution, real-time status updates, file capture and naming, drone flight logging.

tasks.name: Post-Production
tasks.description: Raw file organization, Sparrow handoff for editing, revision tracking, and final export.

tasks.name: Client Delivery
tasks.description: Final deliverable packaging, invoicing, client notification, and project archival.

triggers.description: Triggered when a new task is created in the EEVL Production ClickUp space with the 'new-project' tag.
Triggered when a message is posted to the #new-projects Lark channel with the @eevl-bot mention.
Manually triggered by a team member through the EEVL dashboard or CLI.

mcp_connections.description: File storage for briefs, raw footage, edited deliverables, and client-shared folders.
Team communication, project channels, shoot-day status updates, and Sparrow handoff via #edited-by-sparrow.
Invoice generation and payment tracking for completed projects.
Client communication — delivery emails with download links and invoice attachments.

sub_agents.name: Sparrow Handoff Agent
sub_agents.description: Packages raw files from a completed shoot, organizes them by pillar (Video/Drone/Photo), and posts a structured handoff message to the #edited-by-sparrow Lark channel for Sparrow to pick up and edit.
